description: This file defines the DefaultLayersMethodProvider class which implements IGlobalMethodProvider. It provides global methods related to HTTP context, user authentication, roles, URL matching, and culture information for OrchardCore layers.

classes.name: DefaultLayersMethodProvider
classes.description: Provides global methods for layer conditions such as homepage, authentication, roles, URL matching, and culture.

methods.name: DefaultLayersMethodProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes global methods for layer conditions.

methods.name: GetMethods
methods.description: Returns all the global methods provided by this class.
